description: This file defines the EmployeeService class within the OrangeHRM project, providing methods for managing employee data, including CRUD operations, event dispatching, subordinate and supervisor relations, and validation routines. It interacts with data access objects and other services to encapsulate business logic related to employees.

classes.name: EmployeeService
classes.description: Service class managing employee operations such as creation, update, deletion, retrieval, and related event dispatching within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getEmployeeDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EmployeeDao instance for data access operations related to employees.

methods.name: setEmployeeDao
methods.description: Sets the EmployeeDao instance, allowing dependency injection.

methods.name: getEmployeeEventService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EmployeeEventService instance for managing employee-related events.

methods.name: getEmployeeTerminationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EmployeeTerminationService instance.

methods.name: getIDGeneratorService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the IDGeneratorService instance for generating unique IDs.

methods.name: getEmployeeList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of employees matching provided search filters.

methods.name: getEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees matching provided search filters.

methods.name: saveEmployee
methods.description: Persists an Employee entity and dispatches the EmployeeSavedEvent.

methods.name: saveNewEmployee
methods.description: Generates a new ID and saves a new Employee entity.

methods.name: dispatchAddEmployeeEvent
methods.description: Dispatches events indicating a new employee has been added.

methods.name: updateEmployeePersonalDetails
methods.description: Updates and saves employee personal details, and logs the update event.

methods.name: updateEmployeeJobDetails
methods.description: Updates and saves employee job-related details.

methods.name: dispatchJoinedDateChangedEvent
methods.description: Dispatches an event when an employee's join date changes.

methods.name: getEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an Employee by their employee number.

methods.name: getNumberOfEmployees
methods.description: Gets the total number of employees, optionally including terminated employees.

methods.name: getSubordinateIdListBySupervisorId
methods.description: Returns list of subordinate employee IDs under a supervisor, optionally including the entire chain.

methods.name: getSubordinateList
methods.description: Returns a list of subordinate Employee objects under a supervisor.

methods.name: isSupervisor
methods.description: Checks if the given employee ID corresponds to a supervisor.

methods.name: deleteEmployees
methods.description: Deletes employees by their IDs and dispatches a deletion event.

methods.name: getSupervisorIdListBySubordinateId
methods.description: Returns list of supervisor IDs for a subordinate, optionally including entire chain.

methods.name: getEmployeeAsArray
methods.description: Returns employee data as an array suitable for normalization, given an employee number.

methods.name: getAvailableEmployeesForWorkShift
methods.description: Retrieves employees available for work shifts based on search filters.

methods.name: getUndeletableEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns a list of employee numbers that cannot be deleted, including current user and possibly default admin in demo mode.

methods.name: isUniqueEmail
methods.description: Checks whether an email is unique, optionally excluding the current employee's email.

methods.name: isUniqueEmployeeId
methods.description: Checks whether an employee ID is unique, optionally excluding the current employee's ID.
